pages.text: The factory can't grow on an open field! This entry lists some tools that can help you pave over the beautiful landscape and build the warehouses of your dreams.$(br2)$(bold)Tip:$() Vertical slabs getting in the way? You can toggle $(thing)Additional Placements$() by pressing $(item)$(k:key.additionalplacements.placement_toggle)$().

pages.title: Trowel
pages.text: A $(item)Trowel$() allows a builder to place random blocks from their hotbar when $(item)$(k:key.use)$() a surface.$(br)Trowels also have built-in functionality with the $(item)Roads and Roofs$() mod, meaning that they can place filler items like bricks or flagstones randomly as well.$(br)Inspired by the trowel tool from $(item)Quark$()―A mod by Vazkii.

pages.title: Customizable Blocks
pages.text: $(tfg_short) has a few mods dedicated to adding customizable blocks for very intricate building.$(br2)

pages.title: Copycats
pages.text: $(bold)Create: Copycats+$() adds many blocks that can be $(item)$(k:key.use)$() with another block to copy its appearance. They can be made with a $(thing)Stonecutter$().$(br2)You can check out its blocks by searching for $(6)@copycats$() in $(emi).

$(bold)Framed Blocks$() adds many blocks that can be $(item)$(k:key.use)$() with another block to copy its appearance. Mostly made with a $(thing)Framing Saw$().$(br2)You can check out its blocks by searching for $(6)@framedblocks$() in $(emi).

$(bold)Domum Ornamentum$() adds blocks that can copy the appearance of others and even combine multiple blocks together. Made with an $(thing)Architect's Cutter$().$(br2)You can check out its blocks by searching for $(6)@domum_ornamentum$() in $(emi).

pages.title: Construction Wands
pages.text: Construction Wands are an easy way to place many blocks at the same time. Simply right-click a block while holding the wand and it will place more of that block all at once, making it great for floors, walls, and so on.$(br2)Press $(item)U$() on the construction wand to bring up a page detailing its instructions.

pages.title: Wand Upgrades
pages.text: There are also some wand upgrades to provide even more functionality.$(br2)Wands have durability but can be repaired with $(item)Repair Kits$().

The $(item)Schematicannon$() is an automatic building machine that will place blocks according to a given schematic. You can use it to transfer buildings made in a creative world, or to copy and paste segments of your structures.

pages.title: GregTech Terminals
pages.text: The $(item)Terminal$() will automatically build a $(thing)GregTech multiblock$() using items from your inventory.$(br2)The $(item)Schematic Interface$() lets you copy and paste $(thing)multiblocks$(), while the $(item)Dismantler$() lets you disassemble them entirely in one click.

pages.title: Building Gadgets
pages.text: Unlocked in $(5)EV$(), $(thing)Building Gadgets$() are powerful tools that let you cut, copy, paste, and otherwise do large operations for building.

pages.title: Another Book
pages.text: Building Gadgets has its own $(thing)guide book$(). You can craft one like this.
